# Containment v3 full-bleed production chassis

The built-in image-generation tool created two new Containment-only opaque
production plates from the approved v2 concept:

- `packages/clinical_calendar_presentation/assets/containment_drone_v2/chassis-landscape-v3.png`
- `packages/clinical_calendar_presentation/assets/containment_drone_v2/chassis-portrait-v3.png`

The approved landscape and portrait concepts were the edit targets. Fictional
text, icons, calendar entries, placement rows, progress labels and segments,
planning rows, alerts, avatar initials, and navigation content were removed.
The chassis silhouette, apertures, conduits, ribs, clamps, plating, wear, and
localized green emitters were retained. The cleared apertures are opaque
green-black recessed surfaces for shared live Flutter widgets.

The protected legacy Variant F assets and archived source renderers were not
edited. The prior v2 bridge and nine-slice assets remain historical inputs and
fallback framing for compact/destination surfaces.

## Final prompts

```text
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: production full-bleed Flutter dashboard chassis plate for Containment Drone 47-Alpha
Primary request: preserve the approved concept's exact continuous cybernetic chassis, panel boundaries, conduits, ribs, clamps, bevels, recesses, wear, green emitters, proportions, and negative-space distribution; remove only fictional UI content and rebuild each live-content aperture as clean dark recessed glass/metal.
Constraints: keep the full-canvas composition and housing boundaries; no text, glyphs, icons, calendar cells, donut segments, controls, people, logos, or watermark; opaque output.
```
